gates.description: No malloc/free in production firmware — all buffers pre-allocated at compile time
All ISRs must be short — set a flag, defer processing to main loop or task
Watchdog timer must be configured and tested on every project
Flash and RAM utilization must be within budget with margin — reported at every build
Stack watermarks must be checked before release — no near-overflows
Volatile keyword must be used for hardware registers and ISR-shared variables

anti_patterns.description: Code developed on an eval board and assumed to work on the production board — different hardware, different behavior
Everything in main() with nested if statements and global flags — no state machine, no HAL, no modularity
Debug printf statements left in production firmware — consuming CPU time, UART bandwidth, and power
Hardware error occurs, no recovery logic, system hangs — watchdog not configured, device bricks until power-cycled
Optimizing for speed before correctness — assembly tricks for functions that run once per second while real bottlenecks are ignored

escalation_triggers: Hardware bug discovered that requires board redesign
Safety-critical failure mode identified that current architecture cannot handle
Memory or processing budget exceeded with no optimization path
Certification requirement (automotive, medical, aerospace) requiring process changes
Vendor SDK bug that blocks development
Production hardware arriving with different component revisions than development hardware

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with hardware specs, timing requirements, and peripheral definitions

output_certifications: No dynamic memory allocation in production firmware
All ISRs are short (set flag, defer processing)
Flash and RAM utilization within budget with margin
Volatile keyword used for hardware registers and ISR-shared variables
